name: Happy Lunar New Year
description: Year of the Goat begins 2027-02-06. Mail in the last week of January to every client with 2 or more visits. Chinese-speaking clients get a Simplified Chinese version.
occasion: Lunar New Year greeting (Year of the Goat, 2027)
guidelines: Wish them a happy and healthy Lunar New Year, the Year of the Goat, from their stylist and the salon. Warm, traditional good wishes (health, peace, good fortune) are welcome. If they prefer Chinese, the Chinese version should use natural New Year greetings rather than a literal translation. No offers, no booking push.
